VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No.4144.

SHANGHAI, 31 December 1934.

S. E. REC[EIPT]
D_______
Date ____ / ____

CONFIDENTIEEL

Sir,

With reference to your letter of 28 December 1934,
No.D.6331, I have the honour to inform you that I received
word from Singapore to the effect that Jacob L.Friend called
on 4 December 1934 at the Netherlands Consulate General there,
requesting a visé for admission into the Netherlands Indies
for the purpose of proceeding to Samarinda, Borneo, in order
to inspect there a lot of timber on behalf of the Woodcraft
Works Ltd., to be shipped from there by a certain M.P.Petrosian.

The visa was granted, but cancelled again on receipt of
information from here, he being advised to take out a visa
in the place of his residence.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

〔签名〕
Chinese Secretary.

T.P.Givens, Esquire,
Officer i/c Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

Mr Yao,
Please acknowledge with
thanks.
TPG
JAN. 5 1935

REPORT

SHANGAI M... P...
File No. B-REGI...
No. D
Date December 27, 1934.

Subject (in full) Communication dated 11.12.34 from the Netherlands
Consulate-General re: S. T. Radosteff.
Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by [Signature]

Sergey Timofeyevitch Radosteff is a Russian who was
born on March 20, 1894, at Perm, Russia. He saw active
service during the Great War. In 1923 he left the Maritime
Province, Russia, for Manchuria where he was subsequently
employed first in a turpentine factory at Shatouhedzi Station
of the Chinese Eastern Railway and later in Kovalsky's
Plywood Factory at Iempo Station of the same railway as a
supervisor, after which he worked in the Mulin Coal Mines,
Manchuria, for some time.

Radosteff arrived in Shanghai from Manchuria in November,
1929, and soon afterwards obtained employment in the Saw
Mill of the "Bloch Manufacturing & Lumber Co.", No. 3 West
Kong Foh Road, near Jessfield Park, where he has since been
working. M.S. Bloch, the owner of that firm, is a Polish
citizen of Jewish origin and is in business relations with
the local branch of the Centrosojus (File I.O. 9154.)

It is not definitely known whether the initiative of
the plan to send Radosteff to Netherlands Borneo for the
purpose of inspecting shipment of timber, belongs to Mr. Toeg
of the "Woodcraft Works" or to M.S. Bloch, who for reason
unknown did not wish to apply for a visa on behalf of his
employee and secured assistance of Mr. Toeg with whom he is
reported to be on friendly terms.

（批：* See also File O. 5478）

The firm "Woodcraft Works", No. 19 Central Arcade, which
has a saw mill in Kwang Foh Road near Jessfield Road, is known
to be closely connected with the local office of the Centro-
sojus, with which it has an agreement for supply of Soviet
timber at a low cost. The firm "Woodcraft Works" was
established in December 1932 after a similar agreement between

主题（全称） 荷兰总领事馆1934年12月11日来函，关于：S. T. Radosteff。
撰写人 D.S. Tcheremshansky。 转发人 [签名]

Sergey Timofeyevitch Radosteff 是一名俄罗斯人，1894年3月20日出生于俄罗斯彼尔姆。他在第一次世界大战期间服役。1923年，他离开俄罗斯滨海省前往满洲，随后先在中东铁路沙托赫季站的一家松节油工厂受雇，后来在同一铁路的伊面波站担任 Kovalsky 胶合板厂的监工，之后又在满洲穆林煤矿工作了一段时间。

Radosteff 于1929年11月从满洲抵达上海，不久后便在靠近极司菲尔公园（Jessfield Park）的西康福路3号的“Bloch Manufacturing & Lumber Co.”（布洛克制造与木材公司）锯木厂找到工作，并一直在此工作至今。该公司老板 M.S. Bloch 是一位犹太裔波兰公民，与当地合作社中心（Centrosojus）分部有业务往来（档案 I.O. 9154）。

目前尚不确定派遣 Radosteff 前往荷属婆罗洲检验木材装运的计划是由“Woodcraft Works”（木器工艺公司）的 Toeg 先生发起，还是由 M.S. Bloch 发起；后者出于未知原因不愿为其雇员申请签证，而是寻求了据称与其关系友好的 Toeg 先生的帮助。

（批注：* 另见档案 O. 5478）

位于中央商场19号、在靠近极司菲尔路的康福路设有锯木厂的“Woodcraft Works”公司，众所周知与合作社中心当地办事处关系密切，双方达成协议以低成本供应苏联木材。“Woodcraft Works”公司成立于1932年12月，是在类似协议达成之后成立的，当时

M.S. Bloch and the Centrosojus had been dissolved. The
principal shareholder in the firm is E.F. Toeg, British
subject of Arabian-Jewish origin, who resides at No. 8 Ferry
Road. The organizer and a partner of the enterprise is a
certain G. A. Ravve, Soviet citizen of Jewish origin (File
5678
I.O. 9164) who also is an adviser to the "Kwang Hwa Petroleum
Co.", No. 3 Museum Road, a Chinese firm distributing Soviet
oil products in South China.
Ravve also directs the "Auto-Petrol Union", No. 9 Central
Arcade - a firm engaged in the installation of pumps selling
Soviet gasoline. Ravve maintains a close contact with lead-
ing Soviet employees and officials in Shanghai and it is
rumoured that certain Soviet Agents have on many occasions
resided for short periods at his house, No. 163 Route de
Grouchy.
Radosteff is registered with the Russian Emigrants'
Committee, No. 72 Hongkong Road. He resides at No. 3 West
Kong Foh Road together with his wife and two children. While
in Shanghai he did not come to notice of the Municipal
Police in connection with any political or other undesirable
activities.

J. Tcheremshansky.
D. S.

Deputy Commissioner(Special Branch)

（批：To Mr. Yao, Please reply by sending the Netherlands Consulate a copy of this report. J.B. DEC. 28 1934）

M.S. Bloch 与合作社中心的关系已经解除。该公司的主要股东是 E.F. Toeg，一位阿拉伯犹太裔英国臣民，居住在渡船路8号。该企业的组织者和合伙人是一位名为 G. A. Ravve 的人，犹太裔苏联公民（档案 I.O. 9164 5678），他也是位于博物馆路3号的中国公司“光华石油公司”（Kwang Hwa Petroleum Co.）的顾问，该公司负责在中国南方分销苏联石油产品。
Ravve 还管理着位于中央商场9号的“Auto-Petrol Union”（自动汽油联盟），这是一家从事安装销售苏联汽油泵的公司。Ravve 与在上海的苏联主要员工和官员保持密切联系，并有传闻称某些苏联特工曾多次在其位于古鲁西路163号的住所短期居住。
Radosteff 在香港路72号的俄罗斯侨民委员会注册。他与妻子及两个孩子居住在西康福路3号。在上海期间，他未因任何政治或其他不良活动引起工部局警务处的注意。

J. Tcheremshansky.
D. S.

VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 3893.

CONFIDENTIEEL

SHANGHAI, 10 December 1934.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D ____
Date ____ / ____ / 19__

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that Mr. Toeg of the
"Woodcraft Works Ltd." intends to send to Samarinda (Nether-
lands Borneo), for the purpose of inspecting a shipment of
timber, a certain S. T. Radosteff, born at Perm, 20 March 1894,
holder of a certificate of Registration No. 735, issued by the
local Bureau of Public Safety.

Previously, in October of this year, the company in
question had asked this Consulate General, by a letter signed
by M(?) Veinermann (?), to grant a visa to J. F. Chetvernia for
the same purpose. This request was refused after Mr. Chetvernia
proved to be a Soviet citizen. In August of this year the
same company sent to Singapore a certain Jacob L. Friend whose
record left much to be desired and to whom a British visa,
I understand, was only granted on certain conditions laid down
by the Singapore authorities.

（批：No previous record
of S. T. R.
11/12）

In view of the above I should be much obliged for any
information you may be able to give me concerning S. T. Radosteff
mentioned above.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

〔签名〕
Chinese Secretary.

T. P. Givens, Esquire,
Officer i/c Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

（批：$2, For attention
please. J.H.G
11 334）

（批：DS Tcherepanoff.
S.B. / 12/12.）

先生：

谨此通知阁下，“Woodcraft Works Ltd.”（木器工艺有限公司）的 Toeg 先生打算派遣一名名为 S. T. Radosteff 的人前往三马林达（荷属婆罗洲），目的是检验一批木材。此人1894年3月20日出生于彼尔姆，持有当地公安局签发的第735号注册证。

此前，在今年10月，该公司曾通过一封由 M(?) Veinermann (?) 签名的信函，请求本总领事馆为 J. F. Chetvernia 签发同样目的的签证。在证实 Chetvernia 先生为苏联公民后，该请求被拒绝。今年8月，同一家公司派遣了一名名为 Jacob L. Friend 的人前往新加坡，其记录颇令人不满，据我了解，新加坡当局仅在设定某些条件后才向其签发了英国签证。

（批注：无 S. T. R. 的前科记录
12月11日）

鉴于上述情况，如蒙阁下提供有关上述 S. T. Radosteff 的任何信息，我将不胜感激。

此致
敬礼

〔签名〕
华务秘书。

T. P. Givens 先生，
特别处主管警官，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

（批注：$2，请留意。 J.H.G
11 334）

（批注：DS Tcherepanoff.
特别处 / 12月12日。）
